LibTmux

Description

Capture tmux state in IO and process detached observations with ordinary Haskell collections. Start with withServer and capture; navigation and field access from LibTmux.Snapshot perform no external operations.

LibTmux.Server documents ownership and failure recovery. Typed IDs, checked dimensions and supported releases have their own pure modules.
